lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in four primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The highest-intensity maxima are located in the mid-flank region, with pixel intensity decreasing slightly in the ventral-most row.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a distinct checkerboard grid. These vertical bands are most prominent between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible. The primary ridge in the upper third of the flank exhibits a sharp luminance transition, with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal-facing edge and a dark shadow gradient on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, circular high-luminance blobs visible against the dark macro-mask of the first dorsal fin. Spots are concentrated primarily in the anterior and central regions of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, white linear mark is visible on the lower flank, posterior to the pectoral fin. The trailing edge of the first dorsal fin exhibits minor silhouette irregularities at the posterior base.
other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a transition from high-density, small-diameter spots on the snout to the larger, grid-aligned constellation patterns observed on the mid-flank.
